title: Fix `.DSStore` pattern and consider narrowing `.docx` exclusion.
comment:
**Fix `.DS_Store` pattern and consider narrowing `*.docx` exclusion.**

The pattern `**/**/.DS_STORE` on Line 214 is both redundant and incorrectly cased. macOS creates `.DS_Store` files (capital S), and the standard glob pattern `**/.DS_Store` or simply `.DS_Store` will match all nested occurrences.

Additionally, ignoring all `*.docx` files may inadvertently exclude template files (e.g., `zztemplate.docx`, `zzcltemplate.docx`) that should be version-controlled. Consider narrowing the pattern to exclude only generated output files, such as `output/**/*.docx` or `*_resume.docx`.


<details>
<summary>🔧 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-*.docx
 .DS_STORE
-**/**/.DS_STORE
+.DS_Store
 dist/
-output/
+output/**/*.docx
```
</details>

title: Python version 3.11.14 is incompatible with the `apps2024` project.
comment:
**Python version 3.11.14 is incompatible with the `apps2024` project.**

The `pyproject.toml` specifies `requires-python = "==3.9.7"` for the `apps2024` project, but this `.python-version` file pins Python to 3.11.14. This mismatch will cause the build to fail for that project.

The `resume_generator` project does support Python 3.11 (requires `>=3.10,<3.12`), but the two projects have conflicting Python version requirements. Clarify which Python version should be used or update the incompatible `requires-python` constraint in `pyproject.toml`.
